title: One Fungus Erased 90 Frog Species And Still Spreads
hook: A single disease turned amphibian decline into a global extinction crisis.
closing: Stopping wildlife disease matters because extinction continues long after the first outbreak.
question: Which frog would you protect?

segments.say: The fungus erased 90 amphibian species. One pathogen turned population decline into permanent extinction.
39 percent of affected species are still declining. The crisis continues even after scientists identify the cause.
The fungus hit 40 Australian frog species. Isolation did not protect an entire continent's amphibians.
